column3: Difference of opinion (waw/fa as conjunction vs istinaf); nothing in packet shows ours impossible.
Jadwal/Darwish-based; fa as istinaf vs conjunction is a permitted difference; no refutation in al-Samin cut.
Samin «وكذلك والله معكم» style hal/istinaf both stated for such clauses; ours follows named books; no refutation.
Waw as conjunction vs istinaf is a plain difference between named books; al-Samin silent on it.
Samin: «وأنتم الأعلون جملة حالية. وكذلك والله معكم»; Jadwal: waw third is conjunction; difference of opinion.
Fa conjunction vs istinaf for conditional «فإن»; nothing in packet shows ours impossible.
Waw conjunction vs istinaf; «لو» non-jazim shart agreed by all; no refutation.
Samin: «ونحن أقرب» likewise as the preceding; ours conjunction follows Jadwal (معطوفة); named-book difference.
Fa as istinaf vs rabita vs conjunction among named books; ويل as mubtada agreed.
Waw conjunction vs hal is a difference between named books; no refutation.
Samin: «وأن تكون نافية، أي: لم تغن النذر شيئا»; ما nafiya agreed; fa conjunction vs istinaf is opinion.
Both Jadwal (istinaf) and Darwish (conjunction) cited; ours follows named books, nothing impossible.
Jadwal: «آية حال... أو مفعول به ثان»; ours hal is one of the stated views.
Fa istinaf vs rabita vs conjunction is a named-book difference; هل استفهام agreed.
Same as 54:15:92; Jadwal and Darwish views, no refutation.
Same as 54:15:95; named-book difference only.
Jadwal: «الواو استئنافية اللام لام القسم لقسم مقدر قد حرف تحقيق»; ours matches.
ما نافية عاملة عمل ليس is stated by Daas; fa/waw conjunction vs hal is opinion.
Waw conjunction vs hal is a named-book difference; هو مبتدأ agreed.
شيئا as مفعول مطلق vs مفعول به both recognized; Daas gives maf'ul bih as alternative, nothing makes ours impossible.
Hijazi ما vs non-working is a known difference; Samin states «ما هم منكم» as a sentence only, no refutation.
Samin: «والواو في ولو كانوا حالية»; ours hal matches.
Hal waw with «لو» is also stated by Daas as wasliyya; difference of label only.
Jar and majrur muta'alliq to hal from أعداء vs to khabar is opinion among named books.
Waw conjunction vs istinaf; لا النافية للجنس with جناح fathah on face valid.
Waw hal with «لو» wasliyya/shart agreed as hal; named-book difference.
من شرطية جازمة with يتعد majzum on face; waw conjunction vs istinaf is opinion.
العزيز as sifa vs badal from lafz al-jalala are both stated; ours sifa supported by Jadwal/Darwish.
Darwish: «الهمزة للاستفهام الانكاري والفاء عاطفة على محذوف مقدر ولا نافية»; ours matches exactly.
Darwish/Jadwal both allow ما as mawsul in jarr with ba; ours is a stated view.
